verdict.summary: Round 2's provenance collision is resolved. Plain-grant anchors now include the policy identity in addition to the emitted triple and rule id, and the new real-path regression test materializes the same grant from two distinct policies sharing the same programmatic/blank-node-style rule id, verifies distinct anchors with unambiguous rule-policy pairs, and verifies deterministic rematerialization. The conditional-grant many-source behavior and its loss of rule-policy pairing are explicitly documented and tested as an intentional enforcement-node model, while anonymous-policy and N3 attribution limits are stated without overclaim. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the supplied diff.
